name: Agent Clan
summary: Puts Claude Code and Codex agents on your screen as a 3D team you steer with gestures, voice or a mouse.
description: Agent Clan is a desktop app for Mac and Windows that shows your Claude Code and Codex agents as a 3D team on the screen. You can summon them with a fist, pinch to select one, speak a request, swipe to allow or deny a permission prompt, or circle something on screen to hand it over. A leader can split work across a crew. Hand tracking and voice run on the computer; everything also works with a mouse.

pricing.details: Free; Pro 17 € one-time (launch price 13 € also shown).
